# Open River Labs LLC

> Open River Labs LLC is an independent software company registered in Delaware, USA, operating from the United Arab Emirates. Services: mobile apps (iOS/Android), web platforms (SaaS, marketplaces, dashboards), AI integration, digital visibility (websites, SEO, ASO), hosting & maintenance, product consulting. Works in English, French, Spanish and Arabic.
